# Requirements Quality Checklist: `tollgate serve` skeleton, pipeline interface and the local profile

**Purpose**: Reviewer gate on completeness, testability, security, privacy and performance budget of the 003 requirements
**Created**: 2026-11-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all Stage decision types and their effects on the upstream call and the client specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §US2]
- [x] CHK002 Is hook ordering for response and chunk phases defined, including which Stages run after a short-circuit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 Are all upstream failure modes (unreachable, slow first byte, mid-stream close) mapped to client responses? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, §FR-020]
- [x] CHK004 Is every service of the local stack listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK005 Is shutdown behaviour (stop accepting, not ready, drain timeout) fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]

## Requirement Clarity and Testability

- [x] CHK006 Is "no buffering" testable (flush per upstream event)? [Testability, Spec §FR-002, §US1 AS2]
- [x] CHK007 Are readiness outcomes defined for fail-open and fail-closed dependencies? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §US5]
- [x] CHK008 Is "telemetry never blocks" stated with a measurable outcome? [Testability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK009 Is the smoke check's evidence (trace found, metric found) concrete? [Testability, Spec §US3 AS2]
- [x] CHK010 Are default ports and limits stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-011, Clarifications]

## Security

- [x] CHK011 Is it explicit that client credentials are never forwarded and upstream credentials come only from gateway configuration? [Security, Spec §FR-017, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK012 Is exposure of unauthenticated endpoints (ops listener, simulators) constrained in the local profile? [Security, Spec §FR-021, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK013 Are hop-by-hop header rules specified? [Security, Spec §FR-017]

## Privacy

- [x] CHK014 Do requirements forbid bodies, prompts and credentials in logs, spans and metrics? [Privacy, Spec §FR-019]

## Performance Budget

- [x] CHK015 Is the passthrough overhead budget stated with percentile, environment and measurement method? [Performance, Spec §SC-003, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK016 Is a micro-benchmark baseline required for the empty pipeline? [Performance, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK017 Is bring-up time bounded? [Performance, Spec §SC-001]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK018 Are the not-yet-used stores (Valkey, PostgreSQL) and their later consumers stated? [Assumption]
- [x] CHK019 Is the dependency on Docker Compose v2 locally and in CI documented? [Assumption]

## Notes

- Review pass 1 found gaps in CHK003, CHK008, CHK012 and CHK014; the spec was updated (FR-019, FR-020,
  FR-021, SC-005, Assumptions) before ticking.
